name: Grenada
summary: A red border with six yellow stars, around a field divided diagonally into yellow and green triangles, with a red disc and yellow star in the centre and a nutmeg pod near the hoist.
origin: Anthony C. George designed the flag for independence from Britain on 7 February 1974.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: Courage and vitality, and the harmony and unity of the people.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: The fertility of the land and its vegetation.

symbols.name: Seven stars
symbols.description: Six stars in the border and one in the central red disc.
symbols.meaning: The seven parishes; the central star is the capital parish, St George's.

symbols.name: Nutmeg
symbols.description: A split nutmeg pod in the hoist triangle.
symbols.meaning: Grenada's main export; Grenada is known as the 'Isle of Spice'.

facts: It is the only national flag showing a nutmeg.
Grenada produces a large share of the world's nutmeg.
Its seven stars represent the six parishes plus Carriacou and Petite Martinique.
clues: A red border with stars around yellow and green triangles, with a nutmeg near the hoist.
The only national flag with a spice on it.
Its country is called the 'Isle of Spice'.
